source: Photographed scoresheets; per-round match scores were not provided for this day, only tournament totals. Names transliterated from the original Cyrillic scoresheets; ambiguous surnames kept as last initials/abbreviations as written.
notes: The wins-ranked list's printed value for Andrey M. & Natasha T. (6) was corrected to 5, confirmed by both the win total (only sums to the correct 55 matches -- 10 pairs, 11 games each, /2 -- with 5) and by matching this pair's points total (175) to the id-ordered table; a legend photo provided afterward confirmed the pair-to-ID mapping used to make that correction. The original sheet recorded this day's pair 10 as 'Slava & David'; normalized here to 'David & Slava' to match how the same two people are named on August 29, so the site's automatic returning-pairs comparison recognizes them as the same team.
